{{Top}}
[[File:Maneuverthruster.png|thumb|250px|Maneuvering thrusters on an X-Wing]]
'''Maneuvering jets''', also '''maneuverability jets''' or '''maneuvering thrusters''', were small [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engines]] that increased a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] ability to jink, roll and pitch during extreme maneuvers. They would fire automatically, and while most starships had a basic set of these, special versions of these jets could be installed to dramatically improve a starship's capability. They were installed on the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] ship ''[[Marauder Starjacker]]''.

The [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] on the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] had maneuvering jets.<ref name="AoCI">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial]]''</ref>
